[21] C. Wang, L. Xie, Y . Lin, W. Wang, Y . Chen, Y . Bu, K. Zhang, and S. Lu,
“Thru-the-wall eavesdropping on loudspeakers via rfid by capturing sub-
mm level vibration,”Proceedings of the ACM on Interactive, Mobile,
Wearable and Ubiquitous Technologies, vol. 5, no. 4, pp. 1–25, 2021.
paper_level_summary_zh: 该论文在相关工作部分将目标论文列为现有的RFID语音窃听工作之一，并指出其需要物理接近目标。随后文中引用[7]和[8]作为backscatter-based系统的代表，未直接引用目标论文。

evidences.evidence_quote: Existing efforts include mmWave-based voice detection [1]–[6], RFID-based voice detection [7]–[9], and UWB-based voice detection [10].
evidences.evidence_context: Since voice-based acoustic signals are easily blocked by soundproof materials, direct acoustic eavesdropping from outside a private space is often infeasible. As a result, Radio Frequency (RF)-based communication and sensing technologies have been explored in increasingly sophisticated forms for eavesdropping applications. Existing efforts include mmWave-based voice detection [1]–[6], RFID-based voice detection [7]–[9], and UWB-based voice detection [10].
evidences.reference_entry: C. Wang, L. Xie, Y. Lin, W. Wang, Y. Chen, Y. Bu, K. Zhang, and S. Lu, “Thru-the-wall eavesdropping on loudspeakers via rfid by capturing sub-mm level vibration,” Proceedings of the ACM on Interactive, Mobile, Wearable and Ubiquitous Technologies, vol. 5, no. 4, pp. 1–25, 2021.
evidences.why_this_judgment_zh: 该引用是一个分组引用列表（[7]–[9]），目标论文被包含在RFID-based voice detection类别中，但正文没有单独描述目标论文的具体贡献或能力。属于普通相关工作列举，不能算作具体能力佐证。 原文证据句引用了其他编号，没有引用目标论文编号。
evidences.copy_ready_zh: 目标论文被归类为现有RFID语音检测工作之一，但未获得单独描述。
